thread:
Maya (Product): quick sync — we need to finalize the A/B sequencing plan for model-routing experiments this quarter. main constraints: safety, latency SLOs, and clear rollback criteria.
Alex (Eng): +1. Are we doing RICE-style prioritization for which experiments to sequence first, or is this just the rollout plan for the top experiment?
Maya (Product): both. we ranked candidates with RICE but sequencing is separate: start with low-risk infra changes then model variants that affect output. this thread = rollout sequencing for the highest RICE candidate (model routing opt).
Priya (ML): note on impact vs effort — the new routing yields high impact for latency and cost but medium confidence. effort is moderate because it touches runtime and cache keys.
Jordan (CS): customers with latency SLAs --- we should exclude enterprise customers from early canaries unless they opt in. they asked for dedicated fallbacks.
Alex (Eng): proposed sequence: 1) internal-only 1% traffic to control nodes for 48h, 2) beta orgs 5% for 72h, 3) open canary 25% for 7d, 4) ramp to 100% with staged regions.
Sam (SRE): add safety gates: p95 latency increase > 10% OR error rate > 0.5% => automatic rollback to previous routing. also, CPU/GPU utilization > 85% sustained 5m => pause ramp. deploy-bot will enforce.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary start at 2024-11-04T16:00Z, will monitor metrics: latency_p95, token_error_rate, 99th_kv_read_time, cost_per_1k_tokens. automatic rollback threshold set.
Priya (ML): also include quality guardrail: run eval set of 500 prompts every 2h; if semantic similarity drop (embedding) > 0.06 or BLEU-like metric down > 3pts => rollback. Priya (ML) will own alerts.
Maya (Product): good. need launch criteria checklist before we go to beta: 
- Metrics: latency_p95 <= baseline + 5% on production distribution
- Error rate <= baseline + 0.2%
- Eval quality diff within tolerance (Priya to sign off)
- Cost per token <= target threshold or documented tradeoff
- Docs & runbook updated (owner: Alex)
- CS opt-in list for beta (owner: Jordan)

Alex (Eng): runbook snippets I'll add: 
```
If automatic rollback triggers: 
 1) deploy-bot flips routing flag to previous model, 
 2) alert #eng-oncall, #product, #cs, 
 3) create incident stub and capture traces + sample requests, 
 4) block re-ramp for 24h unless mitigation approved.
```
Jordan (CS): I'll compile opt-in beta list and send a customer-facing note with clear opt-out. want to offer a test window.
Priya (ML): owner assignments: Priya = quality checks/metrics, Alex = instrumentation + runbook, Sam = SRE monitors/thresholds, Maya = business sign-off and rollout schedule.
Maya (Product): timeline proposal: internal 1% -> Nov 6, beta 5% Nov 8-11, canary 25% Nov 12-19, full roll Nov 26 (week-of buffer). flexible if gates fail.
Sam (SRE): make sure we have a canary isolation plan: traffic tagging, KV prefix separation, and a method to drain sessions. won't proceed without tagging.
Alex (Eng): agree — will add request header x-rw-canary: true and a routing key namespace to avoid cache poisoning.
Maya (Product): final asks from me before scheduling: Priya, confirm eval harness run cadence and alert thresholds; Jordan, send beta consent list; Alex, update runbook; Sam, confirm deploy-bot thresholds. I'll sign off once all in.
Priya (ML): will post eval script and threshold numbers by EOD today.
Jordan (CS): I'll have the beta list by EOD as well.
Alex (Eng): runbook PR by tomorrow morning.
Sam (SRE): thresholds confirmed, will add dashboards and pager rules.
Maya (Product): perfect. if anyone sees a blocker call it out here; otherwise I'll schedule the canary window with deploy-bot. :rocket:
